thread.title: Dow Jones vs NASDAQ: how they differ

title: Dow Jones vs NASDAQ: how they differ
text:
Phrases like “the Dow” and “the NASDAQ” are all around when we talk about the stock markets. They’re used so often by the media and industry experts that people lose a clear vision of what each term really means. What is the Dow Jones?
The Dow Jones, or the Dow, refers to the Dow Jones Industrial Average . The stock market index comprises of 30 major US companies and industry leaders that are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and the NASDAQ .
One of the most-watched and the oldest indices in the world, the Dow Jones has grown into a unique microcosm for global financial markets. Widely considered a benchmark of US stock market performance, the Dow includes some companies with the world’s largest market capitalisation, such as ExxonMobil (XOM) and Apple (AAPL) . Ready to get started?
